name: Ловля фігури (1)
description:
Trapping is an effective way to win material. The moment a piece has little freedom of movement, it can be cornered. After depriving an enemy piece of all its escape squares, you can win material by attacking this piece.

What do you have to do?

Win material by trapping an enemy piece. Sometimes you will have to hunt down this piece first.

examples.text: The black knight on f5 surprisingly has no escape squares. With the creative move 1.g4! white can take advantage. White wins a piece.
The bishop on e6 has little freedom of movement. White wins material with 1.d5!

texts: The black rook on a8 gasps.
